items.reason: Both describe imported HTML bypassing sanitization through raw_html cooking, allowing stored XSS on the forum origin.
The reported incomplete Ruby conditional in the embed template is distinct from every golden-set issue.
Both describe i.content.scrub failing on description-only RSS entries and aborting the polling run.
Both describe incorrect resolution of protocol-relative and document-relative URLs in absolutize_urls, breaking imported links and images.
Both describe distinct missing article requests repeatedly downloading and importing the entire feed because retrieval throttling is per article URL.
The comment identifies the historical created_at loss caused by switching Disqus imports to TopicEmbed.import_remote, which is part of this issue.
